title: Structure and magnetic properties of a decanuclear MnII2MnIII2Dy6 aggregate

material_class.structural_family: decanuclear Mn2Dy2 cubane pair linked by a Dy2 benzoate paddle-wheel dimer

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of glycerol (0.5 mmol), DyCl3 (0.25 mmol), MnCl2·4H2O (0.25 mmol), benzoic acid (1.25 mmol) and NaN3 (1.5 mmol) in 20 ml MeCN was refluxed for 2 h in a round-bottomed flask. The solution was allowed to cool to room temperature and filtered. After slow evaporation of the filtrate at room temperature, yellow-brown rhomb-like crystals of 1 were obtained after 7 days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: round-bottomed flask; reflux then slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature, filtered; slow evaporation of the filtrate at room temperature gave yellow-brown rhomb-like crystals after 7 days

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of 1 is slightly below the uncoupled-ion sum and decreases on cooling, consistent with DyIII Stark depopulation and weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization does not saturate at 70 kOe, indicating anisotropy and low-lying excited states, while ac data show a frequency-dependent out-of-phase signal below 4 K, suggesting possible SMM behaviour with a blocking temperature below 1.8 K and a likely low energy barrier.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: powder sample; 300 K; 1 kOe dc field

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility χ″ frequency dependence
measurements.value: frequency-dependent signal below 4 K; χ″ increases with frequency; possible SMM with TB < 1.8 K
